name: agentcheck-monorepo
description: agentcheck — lint & security-check your AI coding agent configuration (Claude Code & MCP)

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace agentcheck-core && npm run build --workspace @bacnguyenne/agentcheck
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace agentcheck-core && npm run test --workspace @bacnguyenne/agentcheck
scripts.release: npm run build && npm publish --workspace agentcheck-core && npm publish --workspace @bacnguyenne/agentcheck
